Mohd Zafar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13
August, 2024
Author: Raj Beer Singh

Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:131064
Court No. - 76
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 23326 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohd Zafar And 3 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhananjai Rai,Vibhu Rai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sandeep Kumar Dwivedi
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicants in Court today, is taken on
record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Vinay Kumar Tiwari, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Sandeep Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2/informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.

3. This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings,
including summoning order dated 09.03.2015, of case No. 1784 of 2011 (State vs. Zafar and others),
Mohd Zafar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178388574/
1 arising out of case crime no. 117 of 2011, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3 and 4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Pipari, District - Kaushambi, pending before the court concerned, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.

entities.text: Mohd Zafar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that matter relates to matrimonial dispute and earlier applicants have filed a writ petition for quashing of first information report, wherein by order dated 22.06.2011 passed by this Court, matter was referred for mediation.
In mediation proceedings, both the parties have settled the dispute and compromised the matter and the mediation report is annexed as Annexure No.3 to this application.
It was submitted that applicants were not aware about the pendency of the impugned case and no notice, summon or warrant was served upon them thus, they could not appear before the trial court.
It was stated that now both the parties are residing together and they have a fifteen years old child.
Referring to these facts, it was submitted that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.

5. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 /informant has concurred with the arguments of learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that both the parties have amicably settled the dispute and compromised the matter and both the parties are residing together, thus the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise.
6. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if parties compromise the matter.
7. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
8. In the instant case, it appears that matter relates to matrimonial dispute, which is private in nature.
If parties compromise the matter, it would not have adverse impact on society.
There is nothing to indicate that parties have any criminal antecedents.
The informant does not want to proceed with the case against the applicants.

Considering the law laid down in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296 and the facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed, as the continuance of the same would be nothing but wastage of time of Court.

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned summoning order and entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case against applicants, namely, Mohd. Zafar, Mohd. Harun, Bibi and Munni alias Sakira are hereby quashed.
10. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
